newsitem.title: USA: Nichols venture wins $193.2 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Nichols venture wins $193.2 mln contract.

text.p: Nichols Research Corp said Tuesday that NCCIM, its joint venture with COLSA Corp, has won a contract from the U.S. Army Aviation and Missile Command worth up to $193 million (AMCOM).
Nichols said the initial value is $1,375,918 with options totaling $193,247,186 over five years.
Under the contract, NCCIM will provide the AMCOM corporate information center support services for automation, telecommunications, visual information and records management.

Nichols is headquartered in Huntsville and provides information technology and technical services for the Department of Defense, federal civilian agencies, state government clients and commercial clients. It has 28 locations in the United States and about 2,300 employees and consultants.
